title: HOLD-LC-001 candidate-neutral estimator contract without score admission
question: Can the nine hash-pinned HOLD-LC-001 event products be placed under a separately versioned candidate-neutral estimator contract that fixes the observable, ownership split, missing calibration and statistical fields, and all four map-stage boundaries without replacing T-054/T-059 or scoring a microscopic candidate?
method: Use the existing HOLD-LC-001 byte-freeze manifest, source packet, set-valued envelope, inverse-lane contract and prospective-freeze protocol by hash pointer; do not copy or edit their matrices.
Freeze Delta_t_det = t_GBM_onset_geocenter - t_GW_merger_geocenter as a retrospective candidate-neutral interface and retain the published 1.74 +/- 0.05 s summary as descriptive provenance only.
Separate physical-owner fields from proof-owner fields and list exact pending requirements for time standard, calibration, timing windows, covariance, nuisance, scorer and F_reg/F_lim/F_eff/F_obs.
Declare every unfilled statistical or map object NOT_ADMITTED, preserve the empty prospective lock, and encode the static-to-dynamic quotient rule so a static fit cannot select a dynamics.
Run JSON, parent-hash, inverse-contract and release checks as design/lineage validation only; do not construct a likelihood, covariance, candidate map, score or physical inference.

exact_scope.evidence_scope: T0 design and lineage interface; finite only
exact_scope.statistical_scope: No likelihood, covariance, nuisance probability law, scorer or predictive distribution is admitted.
exact_scope.method_scope: Additive contract only; existing T-054 forward and T-059 inverse methods, owner order, estimands and parked-loop rules remain controlling.

checks.detail: The contract records the byte-freeze manifest hash and the exact nine product IDs without copying raw bytes into tracked Contents.
The temporal interface and preprocessing rule prohibit candidate labels, parameters and residuals from entering F_reg; exact calibration, windows and conversion inputs remain source-owner fields.
The source summary is descriptive only; likelihood, covariance, intrinsic-lag law, scorer and prospective lock remain explicitly unadmitted or empty.
F_reg is design-only and F_lim, F_eff and F_obs are not admitted until their owners, limits, effective theory map and instrument/statistical map are supplied.
No existing method authority, candidate card, result, negative, physical-empty input or Lean theorem is edited or promoted.

finding: A separately versioned candidate-neutral estimator interface is now frozen over the nine hash-pinned event products. It makes the temporal estimand, product roles, physical/proof ownership split, missing calibration/statistical fields and F_reg/F_lim/F_eff/F_obs boundaries explicit, while candidate scoring and prospective validation remain stopped.
decision_reason: This is a genuine P1 design advance because it converts the previously open estimator obligation into a versioned, auditable field contract without inventing the missing likelihood, covariance, nuisance law or map. It preserves the existing methods and prevents a retrospective static fit from selecting dynamics.
decision_scope: Finite retrospective estimator-interface design and parent-lineage binding only; no candidate comparison, dynamics identification, empirical prediction, continuum interpretation or physical promotion.
assumptions: The byte-freeze manifest remains the authoritative locator and hash record for the event products.
The reported source timing summary is retained as provenance and is not a likelihood.
A candidate-neutral preprocessing interface can be specified before any candidate-specific map is admitted.
The existing T-059 anti-leakage and prospective-lock rules remain controlling.
A design-only contract is a continuity result rather than a scientific result.
missing_assumptions: Source-owned time standard, detector calibration and geocenter conversion with uncertainty.
Frozen timing, background, detector and energy windows plus a missing-data rule.
Joint likelihood or covariance including shared-source and calibration terms.
Intrinsic-emission nuisance law or a preregistered set-valued scoring rule.
A complete owner-approved F_reg/F_lim/F_eff/F_obs map and immutable scorer.

adversarial_review.check: Could 1.74 +/- 0.05 s be silently promoted to an independent Gaussian datum?
adversarial_review.disposition: UPHELD-BLOCKED: likelihood and covariance are NOT_ADMITTED and the substitute is forbidden.

adversarial_review.check: Could hash-pinned response and trigger products be treated as a complete calibration/covariance?
adversarial_review.disposition: UPHELD-BLOCKED: time standard, calibration, geocenter uncertainty and shared covariance remain SOURCE_OWNER_REQUIRED.

adversarial_review.check: Could this disclosed event tune the estimator and later receive predictive credit?
adversarial_review.disposition: UPHELD-BLOCKED: the packet is retrospective, PROS-LOCK-001 is empty, and target-dependent preprocessing is forbidden.

adversarial_review.check: Could the selected H1/L1 and N0/B0 subset be called a complete detector analysis?
adversarial_review.disposition: DISMISSED-FOR-SCOPE: the contract labels the subset as finite intake and keeps completeness pending.

adversarial_review.check: Could a finite timing feature choose one member of a static-equivalence class without an owner generator?
adversarial_review.disposition: UPHELD-BLOCKED: the R-193/R-200 quotient rule and physical-owner split forbid that inference.

adversarial_review.check: Could the new contract silently replace the established forward or inverse method?
adversarial_review.disposition: DISMISSED: method, owner-order and parked-loop preservation flags are explicit and true.

boundary: EXP-001302 advances only the T0 estimator-interface and lineage boundary. It does not admit a likelihood, covariance, nuisance law, candidate forward map, score, prospective prediction, microscopic dynamics, physical identity, continuum result, Reading-H sign, Pre-A closure or mass-gap conclusion.
evidence_level: T0 exact parent-lineage and candidate-neutral design contract with explicit admission stop
next_action: Obtain and hash-pin the source-owner time-standard, calibration, timing-window, covariance or likelihood and intrinsic-lag specifications; then independently reproduce the candidate-neutral F_reg implementation before any candidate map or score, while continuing unchanged T-054 owner intake.
stop_or_redesign: If no source owner supplies the missing calibration or statistical objects, retain HOLD-LC-001 as a design-only feasibility packet and do not score.
If preprocessing must depend on a candidate target, issue a new estimator version and reset the inverse lane to P1.
If the temporal observable is invariant over a static-equivalence class, report NONIDENTIFIABLE rather than selecting a representative.
If regulator, calibration or nuisance changes reverse a finite verdict, report UNSTABLE_FINITE_ONLY.
If a future estimator changes the observation target or uses the retrospective packet for tuning, do not award prospective credit.
non_claims: No candidate is admitted, selected, ranked, fitted or prospectively validated.
No source-owned likelihood, covariance, nuisance probability law or complete F_reg/F_lim/F_eff/F_obs map is present.

No microscopic dynamics, physical vacuum, Reading-H branch, causal cone, Pre-A, Sector-A, C6, A13, QFT, Yang-Mills, gravity, continuum, cosmic-origin, theory-of-everything or mass-gap claim is established.
The existing T-054 forward and T-059 inverse methods are unchanged; this contract is additive and not a replacement.
